no_adcom_quote.quote: This Application was not presented to the Oncologic Drug Advisory Committee or any other external consultants.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for the IDHIFA (enasidenib) NDA209606 approval. The FDA Multidiscipline Review's Advisory Committee section states the application was not presented to the Oncologic Drug Advisory Committee or any other external consultants, and the filing review recorded that no AdComm was needed because the application did not raise significant public health questions. Because no committee met, there are no committee concern-to-change linkages.
